what_changed: Step1.3 flow-structure confidence was used as a candidate-blind interval weight on top of the fixed-support SE(2) likelihood.
interpretation: Structure confidence is candidate-blind, but it is not a universal proxy for action-conditioned correctness.
The weighting improves one model, degrades two, and is neutral on one.
Keep Step1.3 structure descriptors for diagnostics, abstention explanations, and future calibrated uncertainty; do not apply them as the default MAS/RCS score weight.
claim_boundary: This is an internal A/B on existing raw-flow archives, not a promoted metric.
